newsitem.title: ESTONIA: HUVITUSFOND Q1 PROFIT 41.9 MLN KROONS.
newsitem.headline: HUVITUSFOND Q1 PROFIT 41.9 MLN KROONS.

text.p: Huvitusfond (the compensation fund) said on Tuesday that its first quarter profit was 41.9 million kroons and it 1997 March profit was 14.5 million kroons.
The fund's revenue in the first quarter was 63.3 million kroons, which was almost three times the 1996 first quarter results, the company said in a statement.
Most of the company's income was interest income at 27.3 million kroons and from share trading at 35.2 million kroons.
The company's March balance sheet volume rose by 36 million kroons to 1.22 billion kroons compared to February's 1.18. The increase over the month was three percent.
Debts to clients decreased in March to 0.5 million kroons compared to 1.4 million kroons in February.
Liabilities and loans to credit institutions in March was 184.6 million kroons, 51.9 million kroons less compared to February's 236.5 million kroons.
